_label: Troparion of the Martyrs Paramon and Philumenus (11-29), Vespers and Liturgy

commemoration.title: Martyr Paramon and 370 Martyrs in Bithynia

_note: The parish sings the OCA engraved sheet (© 2009, Russian Imperial Court Chant): you/your, and "Philumenus". St John's register setting is thee/thy, which is right for its Royster fixed texts and wrong for this sheet (memory project_packet_struck_hymns_and_edition_register: register travels with the edition). Guarded on the tt row the parish is served (troparia.id=40580). The same sheet is printed in the Liturgy packet (liturgy-2026-11-29.pdf p.3).

_provenance.family_note: OCA. Identical to the troparia row it stands in for.

value.text:
Thy holy martyrs Paramon and Philoumenus and those with them, O Lord,
through their sufferings have received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God.
For having Thy strength, they laid low their adversaries,
and shattered the powerless boldness of demons.
Through their intercessions, save our souls!
